# COVR

COVR operates a self-service phone case printing kiosk at Marina Market, Centre Park Road, Cork, T12 YX76, Ireland. The kiosk is inside the market, by the Graffiti Room. Customers print a same-day custom phone case from their own photo while they wait.
Listed opening hours: Monday–Sunday, 8am–8pm.
Standard custom cases cost €25; magnetic cases cost €30. Pay by card or contactless at the kiosk.
Printing takes around 3 minutes; allow extra time to choose a model, upload and adjust the photo, and pay. No app download is needed.
Supported ranges include iPhone 14–17, Samsung Galaxy S23–S25 and Google Pixel 7–9. Exact variants and stock should be confirmed at the kiosk or by email before travelling.
